2026_04_LA_PHI.headline: Puka Nacua returns as the Rams lose Aaron Donald for Philadelphia’s trench test
2026_04_LA_PHI.paragraph1: Los Angeles gets an important offensive piece back with Puka Nacua returning, but the Rams will be without Aaron Donald because of a back injury, materially changing how Chris Shula can attack Philadelphia’s protection. The Eagles can use that absence to give their offense a cleaner platform, while the Rams regain a high-volume target who can help Matthew Stafford stay on schedule against Philadelphia’s coverage. The game’s balance may hinge on whether Los Angeles can manufacture pressure without Donald while Nacua immediately restores rhythm to the passing game.
2026_04_LA_PHI.model_rationale: Nacua’s return strengthens Los Angeles’ passing structure, but Donald’s absence shifts pressure responsibility across the Rams front and gives Philadelphia a clearer opportunity to stabilize its offense.
